title: Ludwig-Thoma-Straße, Dachau
description:
Room Description
This cozy private room on Ludwig-Thoma-Straße in Dachau offers a generous living space of 14 m2. The room is well-furnished with a comfortable bed, a spacious wardrobe, and a desk, creating a perfect balance of comfort and functionality. The 85 m2 apartment is shared with six other housemates, fostering a friendly and communal atmosphere. The room features modern decor, central heating, and high-speed WiFi, ensuring a comfortable and well-connected living environment.

Common Areas
Residents share a well-maintained bathroom, a separate toilet, and a fully equipped kitchen with essential appliances. The apartment also includes a washing machine for added convenience.

Neighborhood
Ludwig-Thoma-Straße is located in a peaceful yet well-connected area of Dachau. The neighborhood provides excellent public transportation options, including local bus and train services, making it easy to commute to Munich and explore the surrounding region. It combines a serene residential setting with proximity to local amenities, shops, and green spaces, offering a comfortable and balanced living experience suitable for both students and working professionals.

title: Ludwig-Thoma-Straße, Dachau
description:
This spacious and fully furnished 4-room apartment is located on Ludwig-Thoma-Straße in Dachau, offering a comfortable and well-structured living environment with direct garden access—ideal for families, professionals, or shared living.

The apartment features four separate bedrooms, each equipped with a bed, wardrobe, workspace, and TV, ensuring privacy and functionality for multiple residents. The private garden adds a unique advantage, perfect for relaxing or outdoor dining.

⸻

Layout & Features

• 4 separate bedrooms (fully furnished)
• Private garden access
• Fully equipped kitchen (dishwasher, oven, microwave, etc.)
• Modern bathroom with shower
• Washing machine & dryer
• Suitable for multiple residents (mixed gender possible depending on setup)

Designed for comfortable long-term living with both private and shared spaces.

⸻

Location & Transport (Key Advantage)

The apartment is located in a quiet residential area in Dachau with excellent connectivity to Munich:

• Bus Stop “Ludwig-Thoma-Straße”
– approx. 2–3 minutes walking distance
– Quick connections to Dachau Bahnhof and surrounding areas

• S-Bahn Station “Dachau Bahnhof” (S2)
– approx. 10–12 minutes by bus / 5–7 minutes by car
– Direct connection to:
• Munich city center (Marienplatz ~20 minutes)
• Central Munich business districts

• Alternative S-Bahn: “Karlsfeld” (S2)
– approx. 10–15 minutes by bus

– Munich city reachable in approx. 15–20 minutes (traffic dependent)

This setup ensures efficient commuting and strong connectivity.

⸻

Neighborhood

Dachau offers a balanced mix of quiet living and strong infrastructure:

• Supermarkets such as REWE, EDEKA, Lidl nearby
• Cafés, bakeries, and restaurants within easy reach
• Close to Dachau Old Town and local amenities
• Green surroundings with parks and walking paths
• Safe and relaxed residential environment

⸻

Living Concept

• Suitable for families, teams, or shared living
• Multiple residents possible (co-living structure)
• Mixed-gender stays possible
• Quiet and respectful environment expected
• Ideal for medium- to long-term stays

⸻

Why this apartment?

• Rare combination of space + private garden
• 4 separate bedrooms (high flexibility)
• Strong S-Bahn connection to Munich
• Quiet yet well-connected location
• Fully equipped and move-in ready
